Logitly embeds the following third-party components in local and TestFlight builds:

- llama.cpp, MIT License. See LLAMA_CPP_LICENSE.txt.
- LiquidAI LFM2.5-1.2B-Instruct QAD Q4_0, LFM Open License v1.0.
  See LFM_LICENSE.txt and https://www.liquid.ai/lfm-license.

The LFM Open License allows free commercial use only below its stated annual
revenue threshold. Review the complete license before distributing an app.
